create_training_config: create a TrainingConfig dataclass to hold training job parameters like lr, max_steps, and dtype
run_trainer: run the Trainer to execute the main training loop with gradient accumulation and checkpointing
build_trainer_with_fsdp: build a Trainer using TrainerBuilder that wraps the model with FSDP for distributed training
wrap_model_with_ddp: wrap a PyTorch model with DDP using TrainerBuilder.wrap_model_with_ddp for multi-GPU training
checkpoint_and_validate: checkpoint the model and run validation using Trainer._checkpoint and Trainer._validate methods
